PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.3.289
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.3.289
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE and notices in asset directories)
Locally hosted minified display/worker builds; no external requests are required.
Student reader: matching legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs from
the same 6.3.289 package, in legacy/. These include upstream compatibility
polyfills for older browsers. Shared fonts, cmaps, ICC profiles and WASM remain
in the parent asset directory. The modern builds remain available to other roles.
Student module/worker wrappers also load core-js-bundle 3.49.0 minified.js
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/core-js-bundle/v/3.49.0, MIT, LICENSE_CORE_JS)
before PDF.js. PDF.js 6.x legacy no longer supplies Promise.withResolvers and
URL.parse on browsers below its current baseline; core-js supplies these and
other standard API polyfills in both realms. Vendor bundles are unmodified.
